prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” lawyer for every car-wreck case — the right lawyer depends on the facts of your crash (injuries, fault issues, catastrophic vs. minor damage), whether you need trial experience, and your personal preferences. I can help you find the best match. First, here’s how to narrow it down quickly and what to look for:

How to pick the right Houston personal injury lawyer for a car wreck
- Relevant experience: choose attorneys who regularly handle car-accident and auto-liability cases (not just general practice). For serious or catastrophic injuries, pick someone with trial and jury-verdict experience.
- Track record: large settlements and verdicts in similar cases are a good sign. Look for membership in plaintiff-focused organizations (e.g., Million Dollar Advocates) or recognitions (AV Preeminent rating, peer-review awards).
- Local courtroom experience: a lawyer who knows Houston judges, juries, and local insurers can be an advantage.
- Contingency-fee practice: most car-wreck lawyers work on contingency (they get paid only if you recover). Confirm the percentage and whether costs are advanced.
- Communication and accessibility: you should get straightforward answers, regular updates, and a clear point of contact.
- Clean disciplinary record: check the State Bar of Texas for complaints or sanctions.

Where to look
- Texas State Bar Lawyer Referral & Information Service
- Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo (or similar lawyer rating sites)
- Local recommendations (friends/family, other attorneys)
- Check client reviews, published verdicts/settlements, and the State Bar of Texas disciplinary database

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- Have you handled cases like mine? What were the outcomes?
- What percentage do you charge on contingency? Are costs deducted before or after your fee?
- Will my case be handled by you or delegated to another lawyer or paralegal?
- Do you have trial experience in Houston courts?
- What do you estimate my case is worth and how long will it take?
- How will you communicate with me and how often?

Red flags
- Promises of a specific settlement amount or “guaranteed” outcome
- Pressure to sign immediately or unusually high upfront fees
- Poor communication during the initial consult

Typical fee structure and timeline
- Contingency fees commonly 33%–40% if the case settles before suit; fee can rise if the case goes to trial. Confirm how litigation costs are handled.
- Most car-accident cases settle within months to a few years depending on injury severity, need for medical stability, and litigation.

Well-known Houston plaintiffs’ firms and lawyers (examples you can consider researching)
- The Lanier Law Firm (Mark Lanier is a nationally-known trial lawyer based in Houston)
- Susman Godfrey LLP (big plaintiffs’ trial firm with a Houston presence)
- Abraham, Watkins, Nichols, Agosto & Aziz (Houston personal injury firm with long local history)

If you want, I can:
- Prepare a short list of highly rated Houston car-accident lawyers for you to contact (I’ll need your ZIP or neighborhood and whether the injuries are minor or catastrophic), or
- Draft an email/phone script and checklist of documents to bring to consultations.

Which would you prefer? Provide your ZIP code and a brief description of the injuries/damage and I’ll prepare a tailored shortlist and contact templates.
